frames.heading: How to sit this practice exam

lines.say: This exam covers all of BIO1011. Treat it like the real thing.
Allow about 40 minutes for the 20 multiple choice questions.
Allow about 80 minutes for the short answers. That's roughly a minute and a half per mark.

draw.alt: Time split: 40 minutes multiple choice, 80 minutes short answer

lines.say: Do the short answers first, on paper, before opening the solutions.
Only give yourself a mark when your answer has the exact point.
Describe means say what happens.
Explain means say what happens and why.
Calculate means show the formula, the substitution, the working and the units.

draw.alt: Four parts of a calculation answer

items.text: each part can earn a mark

lines.say: Missing the why in an explain question is the easiest way to lose marks.
For rate questions, start with the Michaelis Menten equation.
Vmax 150, Km 3, substrate 6. So 150 times 6, over 9.
With compound X, Vmax halves to 75, but Km stays at 3.

draw.alt: Rate curve with Vmax halved and Km unchanged

lines.say: Vmax down, Km the same. That's non-competitive inhibition.
More substrate won't help, because X isn't in the active site.
Cyanide blocks complex four. Electrons back up, so oxygen use stops.
Oligomycin blocks ATP synthase. Protons can't flow back in.
The gradient gets too steep to pump against, so oxygen use falls.

draw.alt: Protons build up when ATP synthase is blocked, then DNP lets them leak back

items.text: H⁺ H⁺ H⁺ H⁺ H⁺ H⁺
DNP leaks H⁺ back: heat, no ATP

lines.say: DNP is an uncoupler. Oxygen use rises again, but no ATP is made.
If two n equals 6, a G2 cell has 6 chromosomes and 4 c.
End of meiosis one: 3 chromosomes, 2 c. End of meiosis two: 3 chromosomes, 1 c.

draw.alt: DNA content halving from 4c to 2c to 1c

lines.say: In a dihybrid test cross, independent assortment expects 100 of each class.
Chi square is 179.6. That's far above 7.81, so the genes are linked.
Recombinants are 34 plus 32, out of 400. That's 16.5 map units.
The last primer on the lagging strand can't be replaced. Telomeres shorten.
Cancer cells switch telomerase on, so they never hit the Hayflick limit.
Lose p53, and damaged cells neither stop at G1 nor die by apoptosis.
lines.write: no p53 → no stop, no death

draw.alt: p53 normally sends damaged cells to repair or apoptosis; without p53 they keep dividing

lines.say: Afterwards, write down every topic you lost marks on, and revisit that lesson.
